facts.fact: Nairametrics reports that Galaxy Backbone, Nigeria's state-owned digital infrastructure provider, manages the NICTIB fibre network connecting state capitals, federal institutions and MDAs, and runs a 24/7 network operating centre and security operations centre.
Nairametrics describes Galaxy Backbone as Nigeria's state-owned digital infrastructure provider, whose managing director says it operates Africa's largest publicly owned data centre network.
Galaxy Backbone's managing director says its data centre network gives startups, government agencies and businesses access to data services.
Galaxy Backbone's managing director says its data centre network is certified by the Uptime Institute to Tier III and Tier IV standards.
